summary: Verified all 7 review items for special_order_approval notification addressing + config clear_layer. Required sequence ran clean: `python scripts/gate_residue.py --save` OK -> `python backend/test_core_notifikasi_alamat_poc.py` 35 PASS / 0 FAIL (incl. N3b legacy pending_approval docs receive addressed notifs, N4 idempotency, N5 entity isolation, N7 no broadcast fallback, N8 zero residue) -> `python scripts/gate_residue.py --check` PASS (nol residu: 39 koleksi, 24 balance, 11 SO). Additional POCs G-8 (122 PASS / 0 FAIL) and G-9 (119 PASS / 0 FAIL) also green. Wrote and ran 5 HTTP regression tests (all PASS) proving: generate fans out special_order_approval, addressed only to approvers (admin/manager), sales never sees them, second generate does not duplicate (per-person-per-day dedupe), and X-Entity-Id header enforces cross-entity isolation on GET /api/notifications. Wrote and ran a direct DB test on services/config_resolver.clear_layer proving no empty system_settings shells are left behind, while rows with other live overrides are preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: services/notification_service.py `_notify_pending_special_orders()` correctly sweeps all special_orders with status=pending_approval (not only those created via the API) and fans out per approver via create_addressed(permission=('order','approve')); verified by POC N3b and HTTP regression.

services/config_resolver.clear_layer() correctly avoids leaving empty system_settings shells: after `$unset` of the leaf, empty parent containers (e.g. `ar: {}`) are pruned and the whole row is deleted when no meaningful override remains. Rows retaining OTHER active overrides are preserved. Verified by /app/backend/tests/test_config_clear_layer.py.

Agent-to-agent hot-reload warning is real and observed: any edit under /app/backend/** during a gate/POC run makes INV-GATE-01 red due to measurement contamination (bootstrap creates makloon/receiving/hr/alerts system_settings rows), not a bug.
Login response uses key `token` (not `access_token`); consider adopting standard `access_token` + `token_type` for OAuth2-style compatibility (minor DX).

success_rate.backend: 100% (35/35 POC N + 122/122 G-8 + 119/119 G-9 + 5/5 HTTP regression + config clear_layer script)

seed_data_creation: None persistent. HTTP tests only trigger POST /api/notifications/generate (idempotent, per-day dedupe). Config test cleans up its own TEST_-prefixed config_values rows and reverts system_settings to baseline.
